mission: Introduce production identity architecture and vessel commissioning authority without removing the 8.6.38 recovery bridge.

rls_contract.owner_scope: project_owner may touch rows only when an active membership exists for auth.uid() and the row project_id equals that membership project_id
rls_contract.staff_scope: project_staff may touch only explicitly granted operations within an active membership project_id

migration_bridge.rollback: production membership may be disabled while private recovery bridge remains available to Captain for controlled recovery

commission-vessel.result: sealed fleet_vessels row + append-only authority event; no owner membership automatically

invite-owner.authorize: platform role or project owner with owner.manage capability per Dark Sky policy

revoke-membership.authorize: platform role or authorized project owner; cannot revoke last recovery authority without explicit break-glass path
revoke-membership.result: membership revoked + authority event + active session denial on next server check

transfer-ownership.authorize: admiral/captain or verified current owner plus recovery confirmation
transfer-ownership.result: atomic membership transition with old owner revoked only after new owner accepted
